title: Bound on the Virtual Buffer Head
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine with $m$ work tapes over the Boolean alphabet and state set $S$, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on a Boolean input word $y$. If the Boolean tag $b$ correctly marks the boundary of the input head of $c$, then for every Boolean input word $x$, every virtual input-head position $p$ for a word of length $|x|$, every Boolean list $\mathrm{pre}$, and every $t\in\mathbb N$, the head on the added buffer tape in the virtual simulation started from the configuration built from $c,b,p,\mathrm{pre}$ lies between $-1$ and $|y|$, inclusive, after $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a natural number and $S$ is a type
$M$ is an $m$-tape machine over Boolean symbols with states in $S$
$y$ is a Boolean list and $c$ is a configuration on input $y$
$b$ is a Boolean tag satisfying the boundary condition for $c$'s input-head position
$p$ is a position among the $|x|+2$ virtual input-head positions
